Name: Inverted Valley
Author: lusif1
Description:
[b]HI! and welcome to Inverted Valley. [/b]
[b]This mod pack took me a good 5-8 hours to put together and make, so if you really do enjoy the work I put into my mods, consider returning after 15 minutes, and leave an endorsement, it's basically a fancy Facebook like, or go and download some of my other mods, I also made an NPC, so check her out and endorse her if you haven't already, or make your own NPC with my NPC Template : )[/b]

If you do not have GMCM installed, you can turn off inverts by setting true to false in the .config file

[i]What to expect:
[/i]An entire configuration menu[s] (or .config file if you aren't using General Config Manager) [/s]

[b]ALL[/b] of my 'Inverted' mods in one file!

[i]MORE[/i] Inverted items, such as [b]geodes, artifacts, dig spots, and [i][u]more[/u][/i]!

[/b]And who knows, maybe I'll update the mod to include more inverted things, like Artisanal Goods,[s] [i] and maybe even a whole NPC?
maybe you could even make an NPC using my template? Who knows..hehe..  

[/i][/s]Until Next Time
﻿-L.S

*4 of the images in my mode images are using Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)*
